title: marijuana — steadfastness

sentences.sentence: He was switched on after smoking some marijuana.
sentences.translation: 吸了几口大麻后，他兴奋起来了。

sentences.sentence: Unfortunately, the US does not discriminate between hemp and marijuana, so growing it for food and fiber in this country is illegal.
sentences.translation: 不幸的是，美国不区分毒品大麻和能量大麻，因此在该国把它添加它到粮食和用作提取纤维是非法的。

sentences.sentence: Never prepare food for others if you have diarrhea or vomiting.
sentences.translation: 如果你腹泻或呕吐，千万不要为他人准备食物。

sentences.sentence: And the little buggers also use our attempts to expel them with vomiting and diarrhea.
sentences.translation: 还有，这小家伙也利用了我们试图通过呕吐和腹泻来驱逐来的尝试。

sentences.sentence: Do you have any other symptoms, such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, back pain, dizziness or headache?
sentences.translation: 还有其他症状吗，比如说恶心，呕吐，腹泻，背痛，头晕或头痛的？

sentences.sentence: Overcrowding and poor sanitation are common problems in prisons.
sentences.translation: 过度拥挤和卫生状况差是监狱里的普遍问题。

sentences.sentence: She rushes from job to job at a frenetic pace.
sentences.translation: 她发疯似的不停地跳槽。

sentences.sentence: The king's indulgence toward his sons angered the business community.
sentences.translation: 国王对孩子们的纵容激怒了商界。

sentences.sentence: Would it be too extravagant to buy both?
sentences.translation: 把两个都买下会不会太奢侈了？

sentences.sentence: an extravagant lifestyle
sentences.translation: 奢侈的生活方式

sentences.sentence: His story certainly sounds plausible.
sentences.translation: 他的叙述听上去当然很合理。

sentences.sentence: a plausible explanation
sentences.translation: 说得过去的解释

sentences.sentence: ancient pagan rituals
sentences.translation: 古老的异教仪式

sentences.sentence: the importance of religion and ritual in our lives
sentences.translation: 我们生活中宗教和宗教仪式的重要性

sentences.sentence: The lady of the house performs the sacred ritual of lighting two candles.
sentences.translation: 由女主人来完成点燃两根蜡烛的神圣仪式。

sentences.sentence: The number of prisoners increased as a corollary of the government's determination to combat violent crime.
sentences.translation: 政府决心打击暴力犯罪，其后果是囚犯数量增加了。

sentences.sentence: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
sentences.translation: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

sentences.sentence: ...following the revelation of his affair with a former secretary.
sentences.translation: …在他和前任秘书的风流韵事被揭露之后。

sentences.sentence: an indignant reply
sentences.translation: 愤慨的回复

sentences.sentence: Labradors are gentle, docile dogs.
sentences.translation: 拉布拉多犬温和驯服。

sentences.sentence: Her tone was that of a parent to a disobedient child.
sentences.translation: 她的声音听上去好像家长在教训不听话的小孩。

sentences.sentence: His story became a parable for the fickleness of art and life.
sentences.translation: 他的故事成为一个说明艺术与生活变化无常的寓言。

sentences.sentence: Tears of gratitude filled her eyes.
sentences.translation: 她眼里充满感激的泪水。

sentences.sentence: He felt that she had betrayed him.
sentences.translation: 他感觉她背叛了自己。

sentences.sentence: She had betrayed her parents' trust .
sentences.translation: 她辜负了父母对她的信任。

sentences.sentence: I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
sentences.translation: 我永远不会泄露秘密。

sentences.sentence: They'd conspired to overthrow the government.
sentences.translation: 他们曾合谋推翻政府。

sentences.sentence: For that steadfastness and courage, he'll always be our hero.
sentences.translation: 由于他的坚定和勇敢，他将是我们永远的英雄。

sentences.sentence: Kao's Chinese restaurant to praise him for his steadfastness in protecting America's (read: our) interests.
sentences.translation: Kao's中餐馆共进晚餐，并赞扬了他在保护写作美帝读作我朝的国家利益中体现出的坚定不移的立场。

sentences.sentence: The former American President George Bush Senior, now 85, praised his former Soviet counterpart Mikhail Gorbachev for what he called his steadfastness in the face of immense challenges.
sentences.translation: 现年85岁的前美国总统布什称赞前苏联领袖戈尔巴乔夫面临巨大挑战时的坚定不移。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 7 单元

marijuana
音标：英 /,mærɪ'hwɑːnə/  美 /,mærə'wɑnə/
n. 大麻
例句：He was switched on after smoking some marijuana.
吸了几口大麻后，他兴奋起来了。
例句：Unfortunately, the US does not discriminate between hemp and marijuana, so growing it for food and fiber in this country is illegal.
不幸的是，美国不区分毒品大麻和能量大麻，因此在该国把它添加它到粮食和用作提取纤维是非法的。

diarrhea
音标：英 /,daɪə'riə/  美 /,daɪə'riə/
n. 腹泻
短语：infantile diarrhea — 幼儿腹泻；婴儿腹泻
例句：Never prepare food for others if you have diarrhea or vomiting.
如果你腹泻或呕吐，千万不要为他人准备食物。
例句：And the little buggers also use our attempts to expel them with vomiting and diarrhea.
还有，这小家伙也利用了我们试图通过呕吐和腹泻来驱逐来的尝试。
例句：Do you have any other symptoms, such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, back pain, dizziness or headache?
还有其他症状吗，比如说恶心，呕吐，腹泻，背痛，头晕或头痛的？

sanitation
音标：英 /sænɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,sænɪ'teʃən/
n. 卫生设备，卫生环境
短语：environmental sanitation — 环境卫生
短语：food sanitation — 食品卫生
短语：sanitation worker — 环卫工人
例句：Overcrowding and poor sanitation are common problems in prisons.
过度拥挤和卫生状况差是监狱里的普遍问题。

frenetic
音标：英 /frə'netɪk/  美 /frə'nɛtɪk/
adj. 发狂的，狂热的
例句：She rushes from job to job at a frenetic pace.
她发疯似的不停地跳槽。

indulgence
音标：英 /ɪn'dʌldʒ(ə)ns/  美 /ɪn'dʌldʒəns/
n. 沉溺；放纵
例句：The king's indulgence toward his sons angered the business community.
国王对孩子们的纵容激怒了商界。

extravagant
音标：英 /ɪk'strævəg(ə)nt/  美 /ɪk'strævəgənt/
adj. 过度的；浪费的，奢侈的
例句：Would it be too extravagant to buy both?
把两个都买下会不会太奢侈了？
例句：an extravagant lifestyle
奢侈的生活方式

plausible
音标：英 /'plɔːzɪb(ə)l/  美 /'plɔzəbl/
adj. 可信的，貌似合理的
例句：His story certainly sounds plausible.
他的叙述听上去当然很合理。
例句：a plausible explanation
说得过去的解释

ritual
音标：英 /'rɪtʃʊəl/  美 /'rɪtʃuəl/
n. 仪式，惯例
短语：ritual dance — 仪式之舞；祭祀之舞
例句：ancient pagan rituals
古老的异教仪式
例句：the importance of religion and ritual in our lives
我们生活中宗教和宗教仪式的重要性
例句：The lady of the house performs the sacred ritual of lighting two candles.
由女主人来完成点燃两根蜡烛的神圣仪式。

corollary
音标：英 /kə'rɒlərɪ/  美 /'kɔrəlɛri/
n. 必然的结果；推论
短语：corollary equipment — 配套设备
例句：The number of prisoners increased as a corollary of the government's determination to combat violent crime.
政府决心打击暴力犯罪，其后果是囚犯数量增加了。

instinct
音标：英 /'ɪnstɪŋ(k)t/  美 /'ɪnstɪŋkt/
n. 本能，天性
短语：by instinct — 出于本能
短语：instinct for — 有…的天分；生来就
短语：on instinct — 本能，凭直觉
短语：killer instinct — 杀生本能
短语：maternal instinct — n. 母性本能
短语：animal instinct — 动物本能；野兽直觉
短语：basic instinct — 本能
短语：herd instinct — [心]群居本能，群体心理
例句：Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

revelation
音标：英 /revə'leɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /'rɛvə'leʃən/
n. 启示；揭露
例句：...following the revelation of his affair with a former secretary.
…在他和前任秘书的风流韵事被揭露之后。

indignant
音标：英 /ɪn'dɪgnənt/  美 /ɪn'dɪɡnənt/
adj. 愤慨的，愤怒的
例句：an indignant reply
愤慨的回复

docile
音标：英 /'dəʊsaɪl/  美 /ˈdoʊˌsaɪl/
adj. 温顺的，容易教的
例句：Labradors are gentle, docile dogs.
拉布拉多犬温和驯服。

disobedient
音标：英 /dɪsə'biːdɪənt/  美 /'dɪsə'bidɪənt/
adj. 不服从的，违背的
例句：Her tone was that of a parent to a disobedient child.
她的声音听上去好像家长在教训不听话的小孩。

fickleness
音标：英 /'fɪklnəs/  美 /'fɪkəlnəs/
n. 浮躁，变化无常
例句：His story became a parable for the fickleness of art and life.
他的故事成为一个说明艺术与生活变化无常的寓言。

gratitude
音标：英 /'grætɪtjuːd/  美 /'ɡrætɪtud/
n. 感激，感谢
短语：gratitude to sb — 感激某人
短语：express gratitude — 表达感谢
短语：debt of gratitude — 人情债
例句：Tears of gratitude filled her eyes.
她眼里充满感激的泪水。

betray
音标：英 /bɪ'treɪ/  美 /bɪ'tre/
v. 出卖，背叛
短语：betray oneself — 原形毕露
例句：He felt that she had betrayed him.
他感觉她背叛了自己。
例句：She had betrayed her parents' trust .
她辜负了父母对她的信任。
例句：I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
我永远不会泄露秘密。

begrudging
音标：英 /bi'grʌdʒiŋ/
adj. 吝惜的；勉强的；妒忌的

conspire
音标：英 /kən'spaɪə/  美 /kən'spaɪɚ/
v. 共同促成；密谋
例句：They'd conspired to overthrow the government.
他们曾合谋推翻政府。

steadfastness
音标：英 /'stedfa:stnis/
n. 坚定不移
例句：For that steadfastness and courage, he'll always be our hero.
由于他的坚定和勇敢，他将是我们永远的英雄。
例句：Kao's Chinese restaurant to praise him for his steadfastness in protecting America's (read: our) interests.
Kao's中餐馆共进晚餐，并赞扬了他在保护写作美帝读作我朝的国家利益中体现出的坚定不移的立场。
例句：The former American President George Bush Senior, now 85, praised his former Soviet counterpart Mikhail Gorbachev for what he called his steadfastness in the face of immense challenges.
现年85岁的前美国总统布什称赞前苏联领袖戈尔巴乔夫面临巨大挑战时的坚定不移。
